verses.en: Unto thee lift I up mine eyes, O thou that dwellest in the heavens.
verses.pt: A ti levanto os meus olhos, ó tu que estás entronizado nos céus.
verses.en_web: To you I do lift up my eyes, you who sit in the heavens.
verses.en_bbe: <A Song of the going up.> To you my eyes are lifted up, even to you whose seat is in the heavens.

verses.en: Behold, as the eyes of servants look unto the hand of their masters, and as the eyes of a maiden unto the hand of her mistress; so our eyes wait upon the LORD our God, until that he have mercy upon us.
verses.pt: Eis que assim como os olhos dos servos atentam para a mão do seu senhor, e os olhos da serva para a mão de sua senhora, assim os nossos olhos atentam para o Senhor nosso Deus, até que ele se compadeça de nós.
verses.en_web: Behold, as the eyes of servants look to the hand of their master, as the eyes of a maid to the hand of her mistress; so our eyes look to Yahweh, our God, until he has mercy on us.
verses.en_bbe: See! as the eyes of servants are turned to the hands of their masters, and the eyes of a servant-girl to her owner, so our eyes are waiting for the Lord our God, till he has mercy on us.

verses.en: Have mercy upon us, O LORD, have mercy upon us: for we are exceedingly filled with contempt.
verses.pt: Compadece-te de nós, ó Senhor, compadece-te de nós, pois estamos sobremodo fartos de desprezo.
verses.en_web: Have mercy on us, Yahweh, have mercy on us, for we have endured much contempt.
verses.en_bbe: Have mercy on us, O Lord, have mercy on us: for all men are looking down on us.

verses.en: Our soul is exceedingly filled with the scorning of those that are at ease, and with the contempt of the proud.
verses.pt: A nossa alma está sobremodo farta da zomabaria dos arrogantes, e do desprezo dos soberbos.
verses.en_web: Our soul is exceedingly filled with the scoffing of those who are at ease, with the contempt of the proud.
verses.en_bbe: For long enough have men of pride made sport of our soul.
